newsitem.title: FINLAND: Finnish bourse suffers drought ahead FOMC, Easter.
newsitem.headline: Finnish bourse suffers drought ahead FOMC, Easter.

text.p: * Finnish shares end a shade lower on Monday after one of the year's quietest days, brokers say, blaming uncertainty ahead of FOMC meeting on Tuesday and the approaching Easter holiday.
* HEX -0.67 pct at 2,819.22 * Volume 320 million markka

Shares fell on Monday and the session was the year's least active with volume barely half the normal level due to uncertainty ahead of the U.S. Federal Reserve's policy setting FOMC meeting, brokers said.
Trading was also dented by approaching Easter holiday.
"This has been the quietest day so far this year," one broker said. "I don't see any action tomorrow either."
A 25 basis points U.S. key rate hike was factored in.
"If the Fed raises rates more, stocks will fall, but if they leave rates unchanged stocks will fall," one broker said, adding that unchanged rates would increase uncertainty.
But other brokers said bond and stock markets would take a favourable view and rally if the Fed did not lift rates.

Generous dividends for 1996 attracted investors to Orion, whose B share rose 3.00 markka to 180.00 and was the most traded stock, brokers said. Metra's B share rose 5.00 markka to 295.00 on its dividend and one-for-one bonus issue, they said.

Nokia fell 2.50 markka to 303.00 and was relegated to an unsusual third place on the list of most traded stocks, accounting for less than 20 percent of trade. --Helsinki newsroom +358-9-680 50 245, e-mail news@reuters.fi
